1.title: Distill the LLM, Don't Serve It: Search & Personalization at DoorDash — Raghav Saboo, DoorDash
1.author: AI Engineer
1.hook: LLM reasoning done offline, distilled into small fast models for serving — with four named primitives (LLM supervision, semantic IDs, consumer memory, steerable generation) and specific results (2.3% NDCG, 4–5% MRR, ~1% order rate lift).

1.title: Raise the ceiling: how to scale intent, quality, and artistry with Al | Katie Dill (Stripe)
1.author: Lenny's Podcast
1.hook: Katie Dill (Stripe design leader) on how to avoid generic "zombie UI" when building with AI — maintaining point of view, user understanding, and detail work through AI-augmented design.

2.title: Teaching LLMs to Speak Spotify — Yves Raimond & Jacqueline Wood, Spotify
2.author: AI Engineer
2.hook: Spotify's Large Taste Model—built on frozen-backbone LLM grounding with semantic IDs—powers 1-in-4 US Premium subscribers daily; trained via NEO's four-stage recipe (domain grounding, multitask instruction-tuning, constrained decoding, grounded evaluation).

3.title: The limiting factor—how to design an AI software factory for speed | Geoff Charles (Ramp CPO)
3.author: Lenny's Podcast
3.hook: Ramp's CPO walks through how AI agents uncover bottlenecks across product development (discovery, code review, testing, launches, UX) and shows how the PM role needs to shift as each one moves.

4.title: Why LLM Recommenders Will Be AI's Biggest Consumer App — Devansh Tandon, Meta
4.author: AI Engineer
4.hook: LLM recommenders scale like LLMs and cost 100x less per engagement hour than chat; Meta's recipe tokenizes content into semantic IDs (10 tokens vs 10k), makes feeds bilingual and steerable with chain-of-thought reasoning.

5.title: Marty Cagan: Strong Opinions, loosely held
5.author: Lenny's Podcast
5.hook: Marty Cagan reflects on ten regrets about product advice, including underestimating business viability, product leadership gaps, and insufficient solution discovery — arguing that as AI lowers build friction, clear thinking and outcome focus become harder and more critical.
